description: Capability boundaries for the global-memory harness. This separates core OSS-profile capabilities from optional diagnostics, experiments, and legacy checks.

capabilities.title: Long-term memory retrieval and injection
capabilities.boundary: Retrieves scoped memory pointers and injects a compact Context Brief into Claude Code prompts.
capabilities.external_story: A client can opt into auditable, low-noise memory context injection.

capabilities.title: Runtime hook governance
capabilities.boundary: Manages hook registration, ordering, runtime drift checks, and fail-open/fail-block behavior.
capabilities.external_story: A fresh install can reproduce the expected Claude Code hook chain and detect drift.

capabilities.title: Client support boundary
capabilities.boundary: Declares which clients have stable runtime integration, which are planned/manual only, and which external docs must preserve the narrow claim policy.
capabilities.external_story: External users can see whether this is a Claude Code harness, a Context Brief CLI contract, or a generic multi-client memory system.

capabilities.title: Open-source readiness profile
capabilities.boundary: Aggregates capability coverage, hook alignment, bootstrap, path-config, hardcoded-path, output-contract, smoke checks, external source safety, issue ledger, gap table, owner decisions, and manifests into read-only release verdicts/checkpoints.
capabilities.external_story: A maintainer can run one read-only command to see current blockers before externalizing the project.

capabilities.title: Maintenance control plane
capabilities.boundary: Provides read-only status, doctor, release-check, release-checkpoint, release-gaps, release-decisions, safe-fix, sync preview, and report commands.
capabilities.external_story: Humans, GUI, and AI clients have one discoverable CLI surface for maintenance.

capabilities.title: Shared runtime libraries
capabilities.boundary: Centralizes reusable path, hook, stage, and prompt-loading helpers used by runtime hooks and maintenance scripts.
capabilities.external_story: Maintainers can update runtime helper behavior in one place instead of each hook or script carrying private path and parsing logic.

capabilities.title: Documentation and prompt integrity
capabilities.boundary: Checks README/docs/prompt-system consistency and generates repository-facing catalog summaries.
capabilities.external_story: External users can trust the documented hook, skill, agent, and maintenance surfaces to match the checkout.

capabilities.title: Memory repository maintenance
capabilities.boundary: Maintains local memory files, changelog archives, extraction helpers, stats, and ad-hoc notes.
capabilities.external_story: Useful for this personal memory repository; not required for the external Context Brief MVP.

capabilities.title: Deployment and sync utilities
capabilities.boundary: Deploys local hooks, compares baselines, runs background sync, and coordinates task/session sync helpers.
capabilities.external_story: A local maintainer can keep the personal runtime wired and synchronized, but these are not mandatory for library-style reuse.

capabilities.title: Project context tools
capabilities.boundary: Creates, closes, and summarizes local project/task context documents.
capabilities.external_story: Useful for the user's task lifecycle; external adopters can ignore it unless they adopt the same project-doc workflow.

capabilities.title: Health diagnostics
capabilities.boundary: Provides deeper repository, retrieval, lint, sync, and WIP diagnostics outside the default release verdict.
capabilities.external_story: A maintainer can inspect why a system is unhealthy without making those personal-memory signals mandatory for OSS readiness.

capabilities.title: Self-loop evidence pipeline
capabilities.boundary: Summarizes proposals, evaluations, trials, candidates, and applied optimizations as read-only diagnostics.
capabilities.external_story: The project can explain optimization decisions without enabling automatic behavior changes by default.

capabilities.title: Retrieve experiments and trial packs
capabilities.boundary: Runs retrieve downrank, fallback, task-context, and candidate-quality experiments.
capabilities.external_story: These scripts support local tuning and evidence gathering; they are not default runtime behavior.

capabilities.title: Task lifecycle tooling
capabilities.boundary: Archives tasks, synchronizes phase status, and checks completion readiness.
capabilities.external_story: Useful for this personal workflow, but not required for the memory retrieval MVP.

capabilities.title: Local GUI control panel
capabilities.boundary: Provides a local GUI and reporting views over the maintenance CLI.
capabilities.external_story: Diagnostics UI for this machine; external users can operate the CLI without it.

capabilities.title: Markdown rendering utilities
capabilities.boundary: Renders and classifies local markdown into HTML for human-facing reports.
capabilities.external_story: Report rendering is useful for this local workflow but not required for the core memory retrieval contract.

capabilities.title: Legacy routing and AI runner utilities
capabilities.boundary: Keeps older route gate/audit and AI runner scripts visible while route-system-v2 and current hooks replace the default path.
capabilities.external_story: Maintainers can inspect or retire these scripts explicitly; external users should not treat them as the primary routing interface.

capabilities.title: Legacy deep content checks
capabilities.boundary: Checks personal memory index/frontmatter/content hygiene that is not part of the default OSS profile.
capabilities.external_story: Run explicitly for repository cleanup; do not treat as external install readiness.
